title: Joni Sue Lane Lecture Series: Exploring Space, A Conversation With Astronaut Ellen Ochoa
summary: Free public conversation with astronaut and former NASA Johnson Space Center director Ellen Ochoa on women in science, remaining barriers, and expanding access. Monday Nov 2, 2026, 5:30-7:30 pm, James A. Baker III Hall, Rice; part of the Civic Scientist Lecture Series with Rice's Space Institute. Registration was set to open soon.
why_relevant: Notable free leadership talk in Houston from a pioneering astronaut and former JSC leader.
location: Baker Hall, Rice University, Houston, TX

title: White House Fellows Program, Class of 2027-28
summary: The Foundation's posted Class of 2027-28 application form says the application goes live Nov 1, 2026. Applicants submit Parts 1 and 2 plus at least three recommendation letters (Part 3). The 2027-28 deadline was not yet posted; the prior cycle closed Apr 22, 2026.
why_relevant: A flagship national leadership fellowship; the application opens in three weeks, so recommenders can be lined up now.

title: Houston AfriFEST 2026 (13th annual)
summary: 13th annual Houston festival of African arts, culture and entertainment, listed for Nov 7, 2026 at The KBC Houston event venue on West Orem Drive.
why_relevant: A large local cultural festival with food, music and arts, within a month.

title: Islamic Arts Festival Houston 2026
summary: Arts festival listed for Nov 21-22, 2026 at 2323 Allen Parkway, Houston. The date comes from a craft-fair aggregator, so confirm with the organizers.
why_relevant: A distinctive weekend cultural and arts event close to downtown Houston.

title: Craft Community Day 2026
summary: Free community day at the Houston Center for Contemporary Craft (4848 Main St.) showcasing local artist guilds with live demonstrations and a food truck. Saturday Nov 7, 2026, 11 am-3 pm.
why_relevant: An easy, free Midtown arts outing near the Ion; good for meeting local makers.
location: Houston Center for Contemporary Craft, Houston, TX
